Read the full column by Inho Song, published in July 2026, where he examines why retirement pension returns lag behind and offers policy directions to turn them into genuine retirement income.

item.content:encoded:
U.S.-Korean Diplomatic Crossroads

发布源: 74. Korea Economic Research Institute --Republic of Korea | 抓取时间: 2026-07-31

An Inside View from the Ambassadors — edited by John Burton, with a foreword by Hillary Rodham Clinton and a preface by Scott Snyder.

Edited Volume · 2024

An Inside View from the Ambassadors

Edited by veteran journalist John Burton, this volume traces the evolution of the U.S.-Republic of Korea alliance through the perspectives of the ambassadors who shaped it — from the founding of the Republic in 1948 through the post-Cold War era. Featuring a foreword by former Secretary of State Hillary Rodham Clinton and a preface by KEI President & CEO Scott Snyder, the collection brings together essays by historians, journalists, and former U.S. ambassadors to Seoul, including James Lilley and Donald Gregg.

PDF · approx. 1.6 MB · opens in a new tab
